fullContentHtml:
UPSC Geo-Scientist Online Form 2027 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for the post of Combined Geo Scientist Pre Examination 2027. This recruitment has been issued for 127 posts. The online application process for UPSC Geo-Scientist Recruitment 2027 has started on 02 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 22 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSC Geo-Scientist Recruitment 2027, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 10 January 2027
  • Pre Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Mains Exam Date : 19-20 June 2027

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC Geo-Scientist Online Form 2027?

UPSC Geo-Scientist Online Form 2027 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
